title: Rewrite Template
description: A schema for defining rules and tone parameters for rewriting or transforming existing content.

rewrite_tone.description: The target tone or emotional resonance for the rewritten content.

rewrite_clarity_rules.description: Rules focused on making the content easier to understand (e.g., 'remove jargon', 'use active voice').

rewrite_structure_rules.description: Rules concerning the organization and flow of the text (e.g., 'put key info first', 'limit paragraphs to 3 sentences').

rewrite_safety_rules.description: Rules to ensure rewritten content avoids harmful, biased, or restricted language.
